preconditions_not_extra_producer_stages.meaning: Different complete scientific/API design acceptance; not scientific authority.
Complete implementation, static and tiny inert engineering controls, different whole-source review; no authentic or numerical qualification inferred.
Separately selected current authentic qualification/study authority, rights, host containment and finite original budgets. Conditional authority alone does not satisfy any empirical checkpoint.

Actual implementation/import closure, full route/control records, independent whole source review, information projection/metric/uncertainty/terminal engineering controls
Exact current source/data/model/operator authority and original resource grants; no implied scientific result

Exact sources, licensed primary views, dataset descriptors, exposure history, unresolved original version/supplement gaps; target-free planned trial/condition roster metadata needed for the pre-activity shuffle commitment, never activity/withheld-count summaries
S02/S03 complete count/timing/identity/mask parity and sealed role manifests; target-bearing raw preparation has no fit/select/report privilege
Complete ProgrammeSpec, reference recipes, all 100 groups/574 cases/65 contrasts, fixed source/policies/caps and rubric, condition views and private shuffle commitment
Native/math/dependency parity and scientific operation checks using only training or separately authorized invented operands; no validation target or derivative

All training-stage R0-R8 native search/fold/retry/refit receipts and fixed selected states. R5 final training-observation GPFA is here; its query-dependent observed readout and subsequent training-label GLMs are explicitly S06/E11, not falsely required before query access.

Measured original training-only fit/search and training-derived inference/prompt feasibility costs, fixed cumulative profile partition; no CPU conversion from published wall runtime

Original F/I/preparation/case/tool-only/reference terminal/resource records, all process/descendant absence, first/secondary errors, no scores

Complete global collection permit after every required prediction exists and all producers are absent; no permit on missing/failed role
Full 574-case assessment scores, all signed reference/condition contrasts and private diagnostic ledgers; independent scorer only
All fixed paired uncertainty draws, five multiplicity families and chronology sensitivity; explicit unscorable/failure entries, no selective redraw
Committed aggregate-only reasoning/diagnostic report, blinded rubric, all negative results and declared limitations
Full current programme evidence/coverage/resource/rights/exposure audit, scoped claims and complete or explicit incomplete status

claim_boundary: CLAIMS is a decision boundary after S16, not a seventeenth producer stage. Incomplete operational abort has no E14-E17 and may emit metadata-only S16 disposition; it does not fabricate those products.
forbidden_feedback_edges: No E15/E16/E17/E18 or historical query-target derivative can authorize/revise S04-S09, E07-E11, sources/configs/reference membership/conditions/seed rosters/budget policy. A failure can stop a campaign, never choose favorable cases or restart it.
raw_preparation_separation: E05 exposes count-conservation/role-identity assertions only to the authorized operator, not target values/statistics to learners; it cannot establish reference predictive competence.
observed_query_is_not_assessment: E11 is permitted before agent cases. Its query observed counts and resulting unsupervised/calibration state are legal; assessment labels, normalizers, scores, and derivatives are not.
same_stage_evidence_order: Within S05: E07 then E08 then E09 then E10. Within all other stages evidence follows its explicit dependencies. S07 and S08 may run independently after S06; written order is one valid topological order, not an added compute factor.
pre_activity_commitment: S04 precedes raw activity/target-bearing S02. It freezes metadata/opaque roster descriptors and the existing target-free shuffle commitment; S03 validates all prepared roles against it. A missing target-free roster stops preparation rather than selecting a map after activity inspection.
evidence_reference_not_payload_union: Parent evidence descriptors authenticate lineage; they do not grant access to every parent payload. E07-E10 consume TrainingView/inner-development labels only. E05 raw-preparation target-bearing data remain sealed; only bounded role/count-conservation/identity assertions reach the trusted gate evaluator, never learner views. E06 has no E05 dependency and includes no activity-derived value.
